answer: I'm sorry for your loss. To sell a car you inherited, bring the death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1, and any power of attorney your father signed can't be used because it ended when he died. Also bring your photo ID, the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and odometer form NW-ODO-2; if the car is paid off but the title is lost, you'll need a duplicate title from your state before we can complete the purchase.
